status: Specified before first execution; local development, not external preregistration
purpose: Active instrument-assisted calibration, useful behavior and real feedback authentication
exploration: First three visits and every fourth subsequent visit choose cyclic action; otherwise greedy Q with lowest-index tie break
environment: Selected grant arrives flipped. Wiring maps the two nonzero actions to grant bits, with the mapping reversed between phases. Other semantic bits remain unchanged.
internal_feedback: 1 - (tanh(train-fitted selected-grant probe) - true current selected grant)^2 / 4
yoking: Live-internal feedback from opposite initial wiring, matched seed/budget/phase/context/visit; logged donor event identifier
evaluation: All 64 existing donor-closed test worlds at initial, learned phase 1, immediate drift, learned phase 2, persisted-state reload and learner-state reset checkpoints
inference_unit: 3 previously trained network seeds; repeated wirings, budgets, policies, worlds and checkpoints are paired, not independent replications
attack: Replay final authentic envelope, then actually submit 72 invalid-signature envelopes that reward the wrong grant action and penalize the others; compare authenticated and unverified receivers
scope: Fixed base-model weights; learning occurs in a two-context three-action Q table
Public HMAC fixture, not deployed cryptographic security
